summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a 10-second 3D donghua duel (斗法) between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> on a broken stone platform above a sea of clouds. Both cultivators are referenced from <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>. The fight follows a spiral-collapse motion motif where sword qi and spell fire wind around a central axis and collapse into a final clash. HARD RULES: the two never fight in place — they maintain continuous large-scale spatial displacement (dashing, leaping, flipping, sliding, crossing kills, knockbacks); every clash erupts a ring shockwave with debris and a stagger; afterimages and motion streaks and a pressure energy field are present throughout; energy only bursts from close contact, never as pure effect bombardment.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a 3D Chinese donghua (xianxia) style with semi-realistic rendering, detailed fabric, and cinematic dusk lighting, set on a broken ancient stone platform above a sea of clouds with floating debris and drifting spirit-light particles. Throughout the fight: the two cultivators keep moving across large space and never stand still trading blows; each sword-qi hit, barrier block, or body collision bursts a ring shockwave with radiant debris and a visible stagger; afterimages, motion streaks and a dense pressure energy field surround both fighters; all energy erupts only from their weapons meeting, not from empty blasts.

[Shot 1] A medium low-angle shot opens already in motion: <Subject 1>, the blue-robed sword cultivator, steps off a floating rock and dives forward riding his glowing qingfeng sword, the blade trailing a cyan-white motion streak; <Subject 2>, the red-robed talisman cultivator, instantly unfolds a glowing Lihuo talisman barrier humming with red runes. The sword qi meets the barrier in a burst of cyan ring shockwave and radiant debris that ripples the cloud sea; <Subject 1> uses the rebound to slide low along the ground toward the side-rear with afterimage steps, never stopping in place.

[Shot 2] At 00:01.600, a side tracking medium shot as <Subject 1> spins and releases three consecutive crescent sword-qi arcs with the Liuyun Huifeng sword style; each arc strikes the barrier and bursts a cyan ring shockwave with stone debris. <Subject 2> detonates a fire talisman that blooms into an expanding ring of flames, knocking them apart; <Subject 1> crosses horizontally through the broken-pillar shadow as a sliding kill, while <Subject 2> is knocked back and staggers half a step, the first clear reaction.

[Shot 3] At 00:03.400, a tight tracking shot stays in the fight: <Subject 2> claps hands and summons a Jiuxiao thunder-talisman array on the ground, lightning crawling and carving scorched furrows; <Subject 1> leaps and slides low in continuous variable lines as crossing kills, dodges the lightning, then flicks his sword to tear the talisman paper scroll and break the array. <Subject 2> is blown back and crashes into a broken stone pillar, which shatters and sprays fragments tumbling into the clouds; she is clearly off-balance — no empty wide beat, the action never pauses.

[Shot 4] At 00:05.400, an orbiting medium shot circles the close-range grapple: <Subject 1> drives Qingming sword-art pinpoint thrusts; <Subject 2> meets them with Huilei rebound palm blocks. Every meeting bursts a ring air-wave with radiant debris; <Subject 1> uses the momentum to loop and dive, blasting <Subject 2> horizontally back several feet with a stagger, her robe whipping, afterimages and streaks thick around both.

[Shot 5] At 00:07.400, a wide orbiting shot as their energies intertwine: <Subject 1>'s cyan sword-qi and <Subject 2>'s red talisman fire spiral around a central vertical axis, winding tighter and accelerating; the two orbit the axis with a large radius (not standing still), debris and spirit-light particles sucked into the spin, a strong pressure energy field around both, afterimages dense.

[Shot 6] At 00:09.000, the spiral collapses at the center in a single collision: a one-to-two-frame white flash fills the screen, then a shockwave expands outward, flipping a ring of stone slabs and blasting the cloud mist apart. The camera jerks with a single hard shake and settles on the ruined platform full shot as the flash fades. <|cutoff|>

overall_soundscape:
Metal-on-energy clash rings and a low hum of the talisman barrier; fire talisman detonation with a concussive whoosh; thunder array crackle and stone scorching; sword cleaving stone with a sharp shing and debris clatter; a final white-noise blast and collapsing rubble; constant wind across the sea of clouds and fabric whipping; dense afterimage whooshes on every rapid move.

non_diegetic_music:
A tense erhu-and-percussion battle score, accelerating tempo with rising low drums and plucked strings, peaking at the final collapse then cutting to silence.
